read.thesis: POSCO Holdings Q2 2026 OP KRW 819bn (+16% QoQ); steel OP KRW 274bn at 2.9% margin with carbon steel ASP up to KRW 962,000/t, but Argentina lithium and Pilbara spread remain fragile and Q3 lithium output dips.

utilisation.quote: we are targeting crude steel production of approximately 9 million tonnes, which would represent our maximum production level

capex.quote: CapEx of KRW 2 trillion was administered this quarter, totaling KRW 3.7 trillion of CapEx for the first half.

triggers.label: Crude steel target ~9mt, maximum level
triggers.quote: we are targeting crude steel production of approximately 9 million tonnes, which would represent our maximum production level

triggers.label: Carbon steel ASP KRW 920k → 962k/t
triggers.quote: the average selling price of carbon steel products increased from KRW 920,000 per tonne in the first quarter to KRW 962,000 per tonne in the second quarter

triggers.label: Chinese steel subsidiaries divested
triggers.quote: The divestment of PZSS and Chinese subsidiaries are now complete

triggers.label: Pilbara spread unfavourable in H2
triggers.quote: Currently, the price spread is not in our favor, so we face profit pressures in the second half.

triggers.label: Argentina Q3 output dips for repairs
triggers.quote: a temporary drop in production volume seems inevitable

guidance.quote: we expect POSCO's profitability to maintain its quarter-over-quarter improvement in the third quarter
we are targeting crude steel production of approximately 9 million tonnes
By '28, we expect to generate KRW 3.5 trillion of STS resulting from these projects.

guidance.value: full operation in Q4 with certified product sales
guidance.quote: Starting in the fourth quarter, however, the plant will run at full operation.
